column1: # Extra function entries for the SPU lift (tools/spu/lift_spu.py), 1.29. Entries the lifter does not find because
# only a computed branch reaches them, seen in the SPU interpreter at run time: SPU_INTERP_HIST=1 lines
# "[interp-hist] img=2 ovl=<image> start=<lsa>" (ovl = the resident overlay, i.e. the job module the code belongs to).
# Seeds outside a module's code are dropped by keep_seeds and listed in the lift log.
